sources.citation: ComparaLex word list 217 'Nkukoli [nbo]' (Canada Institute of Linguistics): the Nkukoli entries of Williamson, Kay & Kiyoshi Shimizu (eds.) 1968 / Williamson (ed.) 1973, Benue-Congo Comparative Wordlist, vols. I-II, Ibadan: West African Linguistic Society; 61 items (BCCW nos. 001, 050, 060-117), data submitted by Roger Blench. [open digital derivative of A's work 0]
sources.note: No prose at all. Every form carries tone diacritics (acute = H, grave = L, circumflex = falling, caron = rising; e.g. ì-tɔ̌ 'raphia palm', wâ 'two', à-kû 'pig', lò-khúm/lì- 'name sg/pl'), so the only first-hand Nkukoli data in print were transcribed as lexically tonal with at least two levels plus contours; this is transcription practice in a wordlist, not a statement, and nothing bears on stress/accent.
sources.venue: I-II, Ibadan: West African Linguistic Society; 61 items (BCCW nos. 001, 050
